title: Sloth with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tree branch -->
  <rect x='0' y='62' width='100' height='8' rx='4' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <rect x='0' y='62' width='100' height='3' rx='2' fill='#A0703A'/>
  <!-- sloth body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='24' ry='22' fill='#B08950'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='18' ry='16' fill='#D4B07A'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='30' r='19' fill='#B08950'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='32' r='14' fill='#D4B07A'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='22' r='6' fill='#A07A42'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='22' r='6' fill='#A07A42'/>
  <!-- face mask -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='34' rx='12' ry='10' fill='#E8D0A8'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='29' r='5' fill='#3A2A1A'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='29' r='5' fill='#3A2A1A'/>
  <!-- sparkles in eyes -->
  <circle cx='41.5' cy='27.5' r='1.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='55.5' cy='27.5' r='1.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='44.5' cy='31' r='0.9' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='58.5' cy='31' r='0.9' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#5A3A1A'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 40 Q50 44 55 40' stroke='#6A4A2A' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- arms hugging branch -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='58' rx='6' ry='9' fill='#B08950' transform='rotate(-20 28 58)'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='58' rx='6' ry='9' fill='#B08950' transform='rotate(20 72 58)'/>
  <!-- claws -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='66' r='2' fill='#E8D0A8'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='67' r='2' fill='#E8D0A8'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='66' r='2' fill='#E8D0A8'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='67' r='2' fill='#E8D0A8'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='74' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#B08950'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='74' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#B08950'/>
  <!-- extra sparkle accents -->
  <path d='M38 24 l1 -3 l1 3 l3 1 l-3 1 l-1 3 l-1 -3 l-3 -1 z' fill='#FFF8C0'/>
  <path d='M62 23 l1 -3 l1 3 l3 1 l-3 1 l-1 3 l-1 -3 l-3 -1 z' fill='#FFF8C0'/>
</svg>
